author: Tanya Sinha
title: Front-End SME | Hands-On UI Architect | Leading Team Delivery & Continuous Learner | Custom Software Engineering Associate Manager @Accenture
text:
Having worked with Akshay for more than two years, I must say he is an excellent professional. He has exceptional skill in front end technologies. I am impressed by his work ethic and communication skills. Plus, he easily adjusts to any given situation or business dynamics.

text:

text:
